local self = require('openmw.self')
local nearby = require('openmw.nearby')
local util = require('openmw.util')
local Actor = require('openmw.types').Actor
local camera = require('openmw.camera')
local ui = require('openmw.ui')
local core = require('openmw.core')
local timingFrames, timingReal, timingSimulation, timingPaused = 0, 0, 0, 0
local timingPrevious = nil
local previousFatigue = nil
local debits = 0
local timer = 0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 local now=core.getRealTime()
 if timingPrevious then
  timingFrames=timingFrames+1
  timingReal=timingReal+now-timingPrevious
 end
 timingPrevious=now
 if timingFrames>0 then timingSimulation=timingSimulation+dt end
 if timingFrames>0 and core.isWorldPaused() then timingPaused=timingPaused+1 end
 if timingReal>=1 then
  print(string.format('M15 course timing: frames=%d real=%.6f simulation=%.6f paused=%d fps=%.3f',timingFrames,timingReal,timingSimulation,timingPaused,timingFrames/timingReal))
  timingFrames,timingReal,timingSimulation,timingPaused=0,0,0,0
 end
 local fatigue = Actor.stats.dynamic.fatigue(self)
 local current = fatigue.current
 if previousFatigue and previousFatigue-current>1 then debits=debits+1 end
 previousFatigue=current
 timer=timer+dt
 if timer<0.1 then return end
 timer=0
 if current>=fatigue.base+fatigue.modifier then
  print('M15 course fatigue ready: current=' .. tostring(current))
  if debits>=3 then
   print('M15 course fatigue settled: debits=' .. tostring(debits) .. ' current=' .. tostring(current) .. ' maximum=' .. tostring(fatigue.base+fatigue.modifier))
  end
 end
 for _, target in ipairs(nearby.actors) do
  if target.recordId == 'FormId:0x1025200' then
   local p,t=self.position,target.position
   local v=t-p
   local forward=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0))
   local horizontal=math.sqrt(forward.x*forward.x+forward.y*forward.y)
   forward=util.vector3(forward.x/horizontal,forward.y/horizontal,0)
   local distance=v:length()
   local angle=math.deg(math.acos(math.max(-1,math.min(1,(forward.x*v.x+forward.y*v.y)/math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y)))))
   local mask=nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.World+nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.HeightMap+nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.Door
   local low=nearby.castRay(p+util.vector3(0,0,100),t+util.vector3(0,0,100),{{collisionType=mask}})
   local high=nearby.castRay(p+util.vector3(0,0,125),t+util.vector3(0,0,125),{{collisionType=mask}})
   -- Preliminary actor-anchor visibility; physical collapse still needs capture review.
   local screen=ui.screenSize()
   local function visibility(height)
    local anchor=t+util.vector3(0,0,height)
    local projected=camera.worldToViewportVector(anchor)
    local front=camera.getViewTransform():apply(anchor).z<0
    local occluded=nearby.castRay(camera.getPosition(),anchor,{{collisionType=mask}}).hit
    return projected,front,occluded,front and projected.x>=0 and projected.x<screen.x and projected.y>=0 and projected.y<screen.y and not occluded
   end
   local projected,front,occluded,visible=visibility(60)
   local anchorHeight=60
   if not visible then projected,front,occluded,visible=visibility(100);anchorHeight=100 end
   print(string.format('M15 course camera preflight: visible=%s front=%s x=%.2f y=%.2f width=%.0f height=%.0f occluded=%s anchor=%d',tostring(visible),tostring(front),projected.x,projected.y,screen.x,screen.y,tostring(occluded),anchorHeight))
   print('M15 course return: lane=' .. tostring(p.x<=t.x))
   print('M15 course aim: target=' .. tostring(angle<3) .. ' north=' .. tostring(math.abs(forward.x)<.015 and forward.y>.99))
   print('M15 course power range: close80=' .. tostring(distance<80 and angle<10 and not low.hit and not high.hit) .. ' close110=' .. tostring(distance<110 and angle<10 and not low.hit and not high.hit))
   print(string.format('M15 course geometry: x=%.2f y=%.2f z=%.2f distance=%.2f facing=%.2f blocked100=%s blocked125=%s farFacing=%s rightLane=%s retreated=%s wallLane=%s wallAlong=%s nearWall=%s rangeLane=%s obstacle=%s',p.x,p.y,p.z,distance,angle,tostring(low.hit),tostring(high.hit),tostring(distance>200 and angle<10 and not low.hit and not high.hit),tostring(p.x>=760),tostring(p.y<=-125),tostring(p.x>=math.max(795,t.x+115)),tostring(p.y>=t.y),tostring(distance<137 and angle<10 and low.hit and high.hit),tostring(p.x>=708),tostring(low.hitObject and low.hitObject.recordId)))
  end
 end
end}}}}
